title: Solutions & Pro Services — Customer Integrations Weekly Sync (2025-11-14)
agenda: Deep dive: BrightCart rollout timing & perf SLO
notes:
Summary:
Small meeting focused on four active integrations. Main risks are BrightCart latency regressions after quantized model switch, and AtlasBank compliance checklist missing two audit items. We re-prioritized a short hotfix path for BrightCart while continuing dry-run for AtlasBank in dedicated environment.

Standups (by customer):
- BrightCart (owner: Marco Diaz)
  - Status: near-production; pilot completed customer acceptance tests for search-rewrite flows.
per_customer_status:
BrightCart — Details:
- Current stack: hosted API -> dedicated routing to us-west-2 for low latency.
- Recent change: rolled quantized 4-bit variant (q4) yesterday to reduce cost. Observed 12% p50 latency increase on cold-start sequences vs baseline (1.9s -> 2.1s).
- Blockers: TLS stapling misconfig on customer edge causing occasional handshake delays; SRE investigating (see PROSERV-355).
- Actions: Marco to push a server-side TLS config patch (PR #87) by 2025-11-15; Aisha to run 2-hour canary with synthetic traffic and KV cache warmup; ETA for rollback/hotfix plan: 2025-11-16.

AtlasBank — Details:
- Status: compliance gating. Private deployment plan drafted; on-prem package staged but missing audit logs for encryption rotation (item in compliance checklist).
- Blockers: Security team requires KMS rotation proof and HSM attestation; Per security, we need signed snapshot of KMS keys and usage audit for last 90 days.
- Actions: Priya to coordinate legal/security call with AtlasBank (target 2025-11-17). Lena to prepare ephemeral attestation demo VM and capture logs.

Kestrel Health — Details:
- Status: internal integration testing; embeddings pipeline needs batching tuning to hit throughput targets for nightly job (500k vectors).
- Blockers: Memory pressure on the worker when batching size > 256; serving-runtime team recommended progressive batching and KV cache pinning.
- Actions: Owen to run a workload sweep with suggested progressive batching config and report perf matrix by 2025-11-18.

MemoMedia — Details:
- Status: exploratory POC for private deployment and analytics pipeline. Customer requested sample retention policy and partial redact rules.
- Blockers: None critical; product sign-off pending on retention UI.
- Actions: Aisha to share retention policy draft and demo snippet; customer meeting 2025-11-20.

Decisions made:
- Short-term: revert BrightCart to q8-compatible variant if latency > +10% after warmup; implement TLS config patch immediately.
- Compliance: AtlasBank compliance items treated as blocking for production; private deployment won't proceed without HSM attestation.

Open risks & dependencies:
- Serving runtime kernel selection for quantized variants may produce unexpected memory growth under some sequence distributions. Follow-up: eng-serving-runtime to run targeted memory profile test (ticket PROSERV-342).
- Cross-team dependency: SRE needs additional monitoring dashboards for TLS handshake latency; Lena will own.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Marco: push TLS config patch + PR (#87) — due 2025-11-15.
- Aisha: run BrightCart canary with warm cache — due 2025-11-16.
- Priya: schedule AtlasBank security call & collect KMS artifacts — due 2025-11-17.
- Lena: prepare attestation demo VM and generate logs — due 2025-11-17.
- Owen: run batching sweep for Kestrel Health and upload perf matrix — due 2025-11-18.
- Team: update confluence runbook with rollback checklist (owner: Priya) — due 2025-11-18.

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Weekly sync next scheduled 2025-11-21 at 10:00 PT. Focus: BrightCart final decision and AtlasBank compliance readiness.

Notes to self (informal):
- Consider adding a small synthetic traffic harness that mimics commercial e-comm query patterns for BrightCart (short queries + cart-context prefix).
- Save time to demo HSM attestation steps for AtlasBank in next call.
quick_actions_summary: 3 immediate hot items: TLS patch (high), AtlasBank KMS artifacts (med), Kestrel batching sweep (low)
